configuration.dataset: BDG2 UCF Panther canonical electricity and weather
configuration.source_policy: Read-only; preserve source readings, zeros, and missing values; no interpolation, imputation, aggregation, or rewrite.
configuration.timestamp_semantics: Ordered, timezone-naive source hourly index; no local-clock interpretation.

weather_validation.source_fields: Retained as source values; no imputation.

coverage_exclusion_count_precedence: Exclusive counts: an origin with any missing target is counted as missing_target; insufficient_history is counted only when all targets are present.
